name: @wizeworks/silica-catalog
description: sparx's silica-native domain catalog — the commerce/CRM composites silica's shipped block library doesn't cover (product grid/card, buy-box, featured, collection header, signup), authored as id-free @wizeworks/silicaui-html Node factories + the grouped palette metadata the dashboard host merges into silica's Insert palette via mergeCatalog. Also home to the tenant theme projections the storefront needs at render time (resolveSparxTheme, buildCustomColorCss). React-free (imports only silicaui-html and the @wizeworks/silicaui Tailwind plugin, the latter invoked as a rule-map builder, never a compile) so both the editor host and the storefront render can consume it.
